_comment: Ontario corporate rates. Every value unverified.

t2_general_rate.source: Ontario general corporate income tax rate, 11.5%. Ontario Budget 2026, Annex; confirmed against CRA, Ontario basic income tax. Checked 2026-09-15.

t2_small_business_rate.source: UNVERIFIED, AND KNOWN TO BE WRONG FOR PART OF 2026. Ontario's lower rate is 3.2% until 30 June 2026 and 2.2% from 1 July 2026, prorated for a taxation year straddling that date (Ontario Budget 2026, Annex, checked 2026-09-15). This pack holds one rate per calendar year and cannot express a change part-way through one, so no single value here is right. Fixing it needs date-bounded parameter segments, not a new number. The T2 return must not be filed for an Ontario period touching 1 July 2026 or later while this stands.
